definitions.rain_day_threshold_source: IMD definition of a rainy day
definitions.onset_rule: first day whose forward 7-day cumulative precipitation reaches 25.0 mm
definitions.onset_rule_caveat: standard agronomic convention, NOT a per-district verified sowing date
definitions.block_note: final block carries 13 days; mean daily rate per block is used so unequal length adds no dispersion
